items.title: Celtic out to erase Kairat pain as O'Neill eyes Champions League return
items.description: Twelve months ago, Celtic's humiliating Champions League exit to Kairat Almaty set the tone for a campaign of chaos. Martin O'Neill is determined to erase that pain.

items.title: Premier League chief Masters says Fifa self-destructed over World Cup plan
items.description: Premier League chief executive Richard Masters has criticised Fifa president Gianni Infantino's World Cup sell-off plan, saying the organisation has "pressed the self-destruct button" by delivering "a self-inflicted wound".
